issues.claim: T121-3 (§13.2, base l. 18583) reads "Auto holds §12.5's frame budget at p95 on the reference and the low-end device over §12.5's reference views (`resolution.p95`)". §12.5 names the object "the reference viewport" (l. 17056), and the canon retires "reference view" for it (G-refview). This round's rendering sweep changed the same phrase "§12.5's reference views" to "reference viewports" in T-ER-26 (l. 14703) and R12-36 (l. 17466), and V12's T121-3 bullet reads "each reference viewport" (V12 l. 2660). Scope's bar is now the only design-text survivor. The canon's pattern `reference view\b(?!port)` misses the plural. Nothing built or tested changes (J141 minor).
issues.required_change: In §13.2's T121-3, replace "over §12.5's reference views (`resolution.p95`)" with "over §12.5's reference viewports (`resolution.p95`)"; nothing else changes.
